title: Track E M2: the generic excitable cell (candidate A) on cells.model.resolved_pump_tissue@3 against independent references: one cell, the passive cable, the propagated wave and the domain limits
status: PROPOSED (drafted 15 November 2026 by Track E during M1, from M1's development runs and the independent references' results; not registered; no judged run before the lead registers it; tolerances below carry their bases, and the development runs named under development_runs_needed decide whether the engine meets them before registration)
question: Does cells.model.resolved_pump_tissue@3, running the generic cell A (c_m 0.01 F/m^2; NaV1.2 1e-6, Kir2.1 1e-8, Kv1.5 3e-7 m/s; the heredity cell's leaks and pump), reproduce independent references for one cell, the passive cable, the propagated wave in chains (with a mid-chain segment), and the block-site junction voltages and peaks against the laws' domains, with closed accounting, at the declared steps on CPU?
engine_models: cells.model.resolved_pump_tissue@3 (src/cells/core/surface_pump_v3_spec.py, src/cells/models/surface_pump_v3.py): cells.channel.nav1p2_m3h_regularized@1, cells.channel.kir2p1_mh2@1, cells.channel.kv1p5_mh@1, cells.channel.kleak_always_open@1, cells.channel.naleak_always_open@1, cells.route.constant_field@1 leaks and junctions, cells.cycle.nak_atp_mass_action_positive@1, cells.junction.junction_voltage_relaxation@1 pinned open, IMEX ARS(2,2,2) with exponential stage gates, cells.heat.trapezoid_nonnegative@1 junction heat, field solver version 2 declared through field_solver_choice.declare() with 0 free offsets, CPU, float64
scope: Candidate A only; held-bath chains of 20 and 40 cells, and the 127-cell sheet at s = 300 for self-consistency only (no independent sheet reference exists); couplings s in {10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, 3000} for chains, and every perturbed junction at s * r_gj >= 20 (D170 ruling 3, provisional); steps 5 and 2.5 us (chains), 5 and 2.5 us (sheet at s = 300); stimuli as the equations appendix section 8 states them (fixed windows, rows every 5 us, APD from the stimulus end in stimulus runs). It does not qualify: candidate B or any other cell; gated junctions; any world with free field offsets; GPU; steps outside the declared set; block below the floor; the sheet's conduction against a reference; re-entry; any biological or species claim.
driver: validation/tissue/excitable_qualification.py (to be written: excitable_probe's chain and segment parts promoted once its step ladder includes its own cap and probe 1's C4 and C5 measurement fixes are made (D170 ruling 6), reading validation/tissue/conduction_observables.py for every observable)
judge: validation/tissue/excitable_judge.py (to be written: separate code that reads the driver's records and the references' results only, D170 ruling 6)

references.independence: written from docs/EXCITABLE_TISSUE_EQUATIONS.md (db488771, then 99fddc35) by a separate agent that never read src/cells, the probe driver or its records; self-tests in tests/unit/test_excitable_references.py check that nothing there imports cells or validation.tissue
references.convergence: the references' own error is 1e-11 or below on every reported observable (rtol 1e-10 against 1e-11 with atol / 100; REFERENCES_USAGE.md section 9's check)

world.cell: candidate A from its 2 s relaxed rest (appendix sections 7 and 8.1); reference rest -79.558918 mV
world.chains: appendix section 8.4: N = 20 (and 40 for the length check), cells 0-2 stimulated at 1e-6 x (c_m / 0.05) m/s for [2, 3) ms, every junction at s_c, gates pinned open
world.segment: appendix section 8.5 at A: N = 40, s_c = 1000, cells 16-23 at r_Na, junctions 15-23 at r_gj, the cases of section 8.5 at s_c * r_gj >= 20
world.sheet: worlds.hexagon(6), 127 cells, 342 junctions, s = 300, under a planar stimulus whose rung launches a front (conduction_observables.launched_front)
world.rows_and_windows: rows every accepted step; activation by linear interpolation between rows (the references' sampled_activation at the same row interval for comparison); every run to 250 ms (S1-S2 runs to S2's onset + 250 ms), no early stop

rules.steps: chains at 5 and 2.5 us; every judged chain criterion is read at 5 us, and the 2.5 us run is the refinement (R)
rules.activation: the first upward -30 mV crossing after the stimulus onset for every cell; for a perturbed cell also its own upstroke, recorded as continuous values (max dV/dt, inward ionic charge over its rise, source fraction); the binary reading is activation_rule.registered_binary, always reported with activation_rule.sensitivity
rules.capture: a launched front (conduction_observables.launched_front) for every sheet control; for chains, every cell activates
rules.stimulus_onset: an abrupt (switched) conductance stimulus keeps its strength times the step at or below 2e-12 m (strength in m/s per ion, step in s), or ramps its onset. In M1 every stimulus refused at its onset, with the cells at rest and every host retry accepted, was refused by the host energy ledger (Resolved pump accounting failed: energy) at 4e-12 m: 1.6e-6 m/s at 2.5 us, 8e-7 at 5 us and 4e-7 at 10 us; every one at 2e-12 m was accepted: 8e-7 at 2.5 us, 4e-7 at 5 us and 2e-7 at 10 us (s = 100, 300 and 1000; candidates A and B; /mnt/workspaces/Cells/excitable-tissue-m1-20261114-01/HANDOFF.md). It is a limit of the stimulus form, not of the tissue
rules.apd: from the stimulus end in a stimulus run, from the largest dV/dt in a kicked run (conduction_observables.action_potential)
rules.near_threshold_exclusion: D150's and MG0c's lesson: an outcome (fires, propagates, blocks, responds) is judged only at parameter values at least 5 % (in log) from the reference's bracket edge; the cases nearer the edge are reported, not judged, and are listed before the run
rules.controls_by_parameter: each arm's controls are judged with their own criteria: the NaV-disabled and passive cell and chain (no overshoot; passive decay against the reference), the subthreshold stimulus (no capture) and the control segment (no perturbation)
rules.one_bound_not_from_the_engine: every tolerance comes from the references' convergence or from a stated physical scale, never from the engine's own spread or its development values
rules.backend_and_timing: CPU, float64, the declared snapshot; costs are reported, never judged
rules.refusals: a refusal is attributed (domain, step, check) and fails the criterion it touches; it is never read as an outcome

activation_rule.status: PROPOSED (M1, 15 November 2026): the binary threshold is chosen here only, with its sensitivity shown (the lead's instruction); the lead decides
activation_rule.continuous_record: each cell's source fraction: its inward ionic charge over its rise from -50 mV to its peak (the inward part of the engine's net ionic membrane current, integrated) over C (V_peak - V_rest). It is the primary record; brackets are derived from it

registered_binary.rule: a perturbed cell is activated when it crosses -30 mV and its inward ionic charge over its rise exceeds the passive floor; unperturbed cells by their crossing; stimulated cells are sources by construction
registered_binary.floor: the largest inward charge of any perturbed cell in the same run's passive (r_Na = 0) cases; measured exactly 0 at every coupling at s = 300 and s = 1000
registered_binary.basis: the only threshold with a measured basis: a passive cell is a pure sink, so any inward charge is the cell's own channels. Every positive threshold is a convention, and the sensitivity shows how far it moves the brackets
registered_binary.known_weakness: it counts weak sources: at s = 1000, combined r = 0.02, the 17 cells it counts as activated have a median source fraction of 0.006

sensitivity.full_table: /mnt/workspaces/Cells/excitable-tissue-m1-20261114-01/records/activation-sensitivity-s300-s1000.json (with the fraction of perturbed cells activated per case)
sensitivity.note: per threshold on the source fraction, per option and arm: the largest strength that blocks and the smallest that does not (null: none). The coupling-only arm does not block at either option for theta <= 0.2; at s = 1000 the combined arm's bracket moves from s*r_gj 20-50 (theta 0) to 350-500 (theta 0.2)
